stem: [41~42] 윗글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
passage: If you bought a banana in the early 1950s in the United States or Europe, it was probably a variety called Gros Michel. By many accounts it was sweeter and tougher than the bananas in shops today. It could also be shipped in large bunches without much damage, which made it ideal for long voyages. Then it nearly vanished from world trade. The reason lies partly in the way bananas are grown. The commercial banana has no useful seeds, so farmers produce new plants from pieces of old ones. Every plant of a variety is therefore almost a genetic {1|copy} of every other. This is convenient, since the fruit ripens predictably and looks the same everywhere. Shippers and shopkeepers can plan their work around a single, familiar product. It is also {2|dangerous}. A soil fungus that caused Panama disease found that what could infect one Gros Michel could infect them all. Moving to new land only delayed the problem, because the fungus traveled on tools, boots, and young plants. Growers eventually switched to a variety named Cavendish, which could {3|resist} that form of the disease. The story did not end there. A newer strain of the fungus now attacks Cavendish and has spread across several continents. Once it reaches a field, it can remain in the soil for many years. Scientists are searching for solutions, from stricter cleaning of equipment to breeding new types. Many of them argue that the deeper lesson concerns {4|variety}. A field of identical plants offers a single target, while a mixture of different ones makes it likely that some will survive. Efficiency gained by growing only one kind of crop may be paid for with greater {5|safety}.
options: Why Bananas in Shops Taste Much Sweeter Today Than Ever Before
One Kind, One Weakness: What the Banana Teaches Us
How to Grow Bananas from Their Tiny Seeds
The Rising Price of Tropical Fruit in Europe
A Fungus That Helps Farmers Protect Their Crops

why: 한 품종에 의존한 바나나의 취약성과 교훈을 다루므로 ②가 제목입니다.
trap: ①은 맛에 관한 세부를 뒤집어 이용한 함정입니다.
tip: 제목은 유전적 동일성과 병의 관계를 담아야 합니다.

(D) 첫 주는 어색했다. 지호가 신호를 너무 늦게 외쳐 바통이 거듭 떨어졌다. 어느 저녁 그는 우진의 손바닥이 붉게 부은 것을 알아채고 언제부터 그랬는지 물었다. 우진은 매일 밤 막대로 혼자 연습했다고 털어놓았다. 지호는 한동안 말이 없었다. 그러고는 자기 테이프를 풀어 그 아이의 손에 감아 주고 더 천천히 다시 시작하자고 했다. 그달 말에는 말 한마디 없이 바통을 넘길 수 있었고, 우진은 뒤에서 오는 발소리를 믿는 법을 배웠다.
